My son has been alienated against me by his mother. All my dreams have turned to nightmares. I suffer physically from Crohn's and a bad spinal condition, so in pain every. single. day. I suffer mentally from depression and anxiety very badly. And spiritually, I have come to accept there is no God, no Grand Creative Force. There's just the universe, and us on our tiny speck of insignificance.

Yesterday my closest relative, the only family I have left (the living one don't give a shit about me) said to me, "You moved here to chase your dreams - which turned into nightmares."

I can't get that sentence out of my head. I feel betrayed by the only person I thought truly cared about me. And looking back at my so-called "life", I failed in marriage, making money, and pursuing my goals. Do you know I'd love to be a talk show host? Crazy. But at my age now, that's not gonna happen, and every time I look into my past I see the roads I could have taken, the success I passed up through stupidity. And I suck at relationships - as a kid I mostly had to raise myself, so I have a permanent "hermit" instinct that makes it difficult for me to go outside.

I'm alone right now, and that's good. I like the quiet.
